title: Post
description: Social media post or blog post entry with content, author, publication status, and engagement metrics. Used for social platforms, blogs, and content feeds.

user_id.description: Foreign key reference to the user who created the post

title.description: Title or headline of the post

body.description: Full post content and body text

published.description: Whether the post is published and visible to the public

created_at.description: Timestamp when the post was created

views.description: Total number of times the post has been viewed

likes.description: Number of likes or positive reactions the post has received
